rows.en:
(Today I'm here to ride the simulator
with Yamashiro-sensei.)

It's been a while since we came here.
How confident are you feeling?
Leave it to me!

That's quite some confidence...
Then let's see what you've got.

Not bad at all.
Just what I'd expect from someone who's
survived Gary and the others' drilling.

But the simulator only resembles real combat.
In real combat, a mistake means death.
You do understand that...?
Y-yes! Of course!

...With eyes like those, you'll be fine.
Well then, shall we head back?

(Today I'm here to ride the simulator
with Yamashiro-sensei.)

(I'm here to ride the simulator with
Yamashiro-sensei again today.)

You really do love this...
If it's the simulator you want,
you could just invite Gary.
Oh, come on, what's the harm?
Well then, shall we begin?

You've become much steadier.
Watching from here, I didn't see
a single thing that worried me.

It'd be best if real combat never came,
but the way you are now, you'll be fine.
I'll do my best!
Yes. Well then, shall we head back?

(I'm here to ride the simulator with
Yamashiro-sensei again today.)

You really do love this...
If it's the simulator you want,
you could just invite Hilda.
Ehehe... Oh, come on, what's the harm?

(Today I came to see a concert
with Yamashiro-sensei.)
Yeah, I've been looking forward to it.
A healthy curiosity is a fine thing.
Well then, let's go.

An orchestra united under its conductor...
How much effort must it have taken
to achieve that sense of unity...
Truly fascinating...

Y-yeah...
I was completely overwhelmed.

The acoustics were superb as well.
To think I'd get to see such
professional work...!
(Yamashiro-sensei is really moved...)

The excitement just won't fade...!
We'll talk about it till dawn today!
rows.notes: Male version (kyou); the female version says konya (tonight).

rows.en:
(...I got to see a different side of
Yamashiro-sensei today.)

(Today I came to see a concert
with Yamashiro-sensei.)
Yes, I've been looking forward to it.
rows.notes: Female only; the Japanese has a slightly garbled polite form, rendered plainly.

rows.en:
The excitement just won't fade...!
We'll talk about it till dawn tonight!

(...I got to see a different side of
Yamashiro-sensei today.)

(I'm here to see a concert with
Yamashiro-sensei again today.)
rows.notes: Male only. raibu = 'live show', kept apart from the concert (konsaato) scene. Aligned: raibu 'concert' (Luis's street shows 'gig'), glossary 2026-10-17.

rows.en:
\p.
I've been waiting for you.
Sorry for keeping you waiting...
No, it seems I just came too early.
Well then, let's get in line.

Seeing a popular artist live isn't bad at all.
Studying up yesterday paid off.
S-studying up?

Only enough to memorize every song and lyric.
I didn't get as far as the performance
bits you only see live.

Well, I'm thirsty.
Let's have some tea before heading home.

(I'm here to see a concert with
Yamashiro-sensei again today.)
rows.notes: Female only. Aligned: raibu 'concert' (Luis's street shows 'gig'), glossary 2026-10-17.

rows.en: (Today was such a nice change of pace~)
rows.notes: Female only; variant of the recurring change-of-pace line (with naa~).

rows.en:
(Today I'm going to Nyan-Nyan
with Yamashiro-sensei.)
Sorry to keep you waiting.
No, I haven't been waiting at all.
I see... Then shall we go?
You're treating me today, right?

Huh? Wh-what are you talking about?!
We're splitting the bill! Splitting it!!

With dim sum, you really can just
keep on eating, can't you.
Each piece isn't very big, after all.

Which is why one ends up ordering
so many. I must be careful.
Well, it's delicious, so what's the harm?
I suppose you're right...
Well then, shall we head back?

(Today I'm going to Nyan-Nyan
with Yamashiro-sensei.)

(I'm going to Nyan-Nyan with
Yamashiro-sensei again today.)
Did I keep you waiting?

You've gotten quite hooked on Nyan-Nyan.
Found a server you like, perhaps?
rows.notes: Male version. Staff member's gender left open ('server').

rows.en: Huh? Wh-what are you talking about!

Hm, with dim sum, the table fills up
in no time.
The little steamer baskets are piling up.

The staff here can't afford to let
their guard down.
rows.notes: Meaning: with tables filling so fast, the staff must stay on their toes.

rows.en: Y-yeah, I guess that's true...
Let's call it a day here, shall we?

(I'm going to Nyan-Nyan with
Yamashiro-sensei again today.)

You've gotten quite hooked on Nyan-Nyan.
Are you interested in the staff uniforms?

uncertain: c06747/c06758: yamucha rendered 'dim sum' (more familiar in English than 'yum cha').
c06756: suki na ten'in 'a staff member you like' rendered 'a server you like' to keep the server's gender open.
c06760: ten'in mo ki ga nukenai read as 'the staff can't let their guard down' (busy clearing the steamer baskets).
